subject: Your 2AM gut check vs the scanner
preview_text: What you saw at 2AM vs what the scanner saw at 2:01AM — the difference is embarrassing
body_paragraphs: Remember that last time you stayed up late, staring at a text, feeling something was off but couldn't name it? You re-read it, convinced yourself you were overthinking, and went to sleep unsettled. That was your gut trying to warn you, but without the words to explain why.

Here's the embarrassing part: when you finally ran that same conversation through Red Flag Scanner AI, it spotted the gaslighting pattern in 12 seconds. The same words you'd been chewing on for hours — the scanner called it 'classic deflection with a side of blame-shift.' And you felt that wave of relief, like finally someone told you what your gut was screaming.

That's the contrast. Before, you were alone in the dark, guessing. After, you have a toxicity score, a breakdown, and a clear read on whether they're love bombing or actually interested. The scanner doesn't sleep, doesn't doubt, and doesn't make excuses for them. It just shows you the reality you were too scared to see.

Open the app right now, pull up that conversation you've been avoiding, and run a scan. One screenshot, and you'll know. P.S. The pattern detection works across texts from last month too — see if the same red flags keep showing up.
